_comment: Copy to data/config.json and edit. Everything here is also editable from the web UI; the UI writes this same file. All keys are optional — anything omitted falls back to the defaults in app/config.py.

loudness._comment: Per-track volume normalization (EBU R128). Each track is measured once in the background, then played at a fixed gain so loud songs are pulled down and quiet ones lifted. enabled=false keeps the legacy dynamic loudnorm chain. window_seconds is how much of the START of each file is analyzed (0 = the whole file); changing it re-measures the library.

icecast._comment: Icecast delivery for external players (Winamp / VLC / Sonos). The app runs a managed icecast2 and relays the stream into it. In Docker these come from the .env ICECAST_* / VDJ_ICECAST_* vars; on bare metal set them here. public_port must equal port for the single-container setup.
